g.text: Sequence (b) - document indexing: ingest, parse, chunk, owner approval, embed, Qdrant
1. Ingestion: the document is stored but NOT searchable
real type from the bytes, size limit, encrypted PDF,
DOCX zip bomb / macros, XML through defusedxml
2. Human approval: the owner makes the version searchable
Qdrant is written first: if SQLite then fails, the stray vectors are ignored,
because search only returns passages with indexed = 1 in SQLite.
